integrity: The complete formula is proved by a block-rank reduction and a count of nondegenerate alternating forms. Six finite-field tests independently corroborate the symbolic proof. No external independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic two only; star graph class-three Lie algebras; coadjoint-form rank counts, not coadjoint orbits or representation degrees; historical implicit overlap remains possible.
title: The complete Kirillov-rank spectrum of characteristic-two star graph Lie algebras
